intro: Vatican City covers less than half a square kilometre inside Rome.

chapters.title: The smallest country
text: The whole country is about the size of a large park, surrounded by walls and by the city of Rome. It includes St Peter's Square, the basilica, palaces, museums and gardens.

chapters.title: Beyond the walls
text: The Holy See also owns some buildings in Rome and the papal summer residence at Castel Gandolfo.

keyTerms.meaning: The government of the Catholic Church, led by the Pope.
